assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide editorial illustration for a professional news article about AI model cyber-risk reduction and the tension between useful coding capabilities and safeguards. Create an elegant, visibly conceptual non-photorealistic 3D paper-and-metal illustration: a luminous abstract computational core inside an open but carefully segmented protective frame, fine interlocking circuits, one clear boundary separating orderly connections from a few scattered disconnected fragments. Calm midnight blue, cool silver and restrained amber light. Wide landscape composition, subject centered with generous breathing room, sophisticated editorial visual language rather than stock padlock cliché. No logos, brands, real products, people, recognizable locations, fake event photography, charts, graphs, axes, numbers, data, text, or watermark. This is conceptual art, not evidence of any event or actual system design.
assets.rightsBasis: Generated for this editorial article using the available OpenAI image_gen tool, without third-party input images. No claim of documentary or data accuracy.
assets.reuseDecision: Official Kimi brand files exist and offer limited editorial use but their download requires explicit acceptance of new Logo Usage Terms, outside this task’s approved scope. assets.creator: HM Treasury / UK Government
assets.rightsEvidence: The exact announcement links this s960 photograph and declares all content OGL v3.0 except where stated. Its image markup/caption, downloaded EXIF/IPTC/XMP, and page contain no third-party credit or exception. GOV.UK image copyright standards expressly require third-party image credits on the destination page and otherwise permit Crown images under OGL; GOV.UK terms confirm that reuse rule. This is an asset-specific inspection, not automatic clearance of all government-hosted photos.
assets.reuseDecision: Use the exact neutral institutional photograph selected in the original government announcement, not the unlicensed Reuters politician photograph. Photo date is not established and is therefore omitted.
assets.cropAssessment: HM TREASURY lettering remains intact in centered 16:9 and 4:3 crops. Body uses full image.
assets.licenseObligations: Credit Crown copyright, link the source and OGL v3.0; do not imply government endorsement.
assets.caption: 资料照片：英国财政部建筑标牌。© Crown copyright。来源：[英国政府公告](https://www.gov.uk/government/news/pm-puts-communities-first-in-government-investment-rules-shake-up)；[开放政府许可3.0](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/)。
assets.changes: Only nonessential embedded metadata removed; source pixels and any ICC color profile are unchanged. No master cropping, resizing or re-encoding. Copyright and attribution remain in the visible captions and this record.

deliveryDerivatives.status: Generated and validated in the final static build on 2026-10-25; all editions were browser-checked at desktop and narrow CSS widths.
deliveryDerivatives.process: Existing Sharp pipeline generates proportional full-frame WebP and AVIF delivery images; these are distinct from the unchanged-pixel source master.
deliveryDerivatives.licenseScope: Image and delivery derivatives only, not the article or website.
deliveryDerivatives.visualCheck: Full-frame display derivatives and cover crops inspected; aspect ratio and important subject detail preserved.

excludedCandidates.reason: Page offers free editorial use, but downloaded file metadata states use only against fee and credits Bernhard Huber. Do not remove that contradictory rights notice and publish. Separate Q9 and Walker images have been verified instead.

Editorial use is offered under Logo Usage Terms but download includes a required explicit acceptance checkbox. New agreements not authorized in this task; no acceptance made. This does not mean no brand originals exist.
Uploader CC BY 4.0 statement does not establish underlying application UI rights; image also does not document the present cyber-risk reduction release.
Imprint expressly reserves photographs and prohibits information/editorial reuse without written permission; no separate asset-level grant found.

Usable CC BY-SA 4.0 original was downloaded and inspected. Older close view with a barge in foreground adds little necessary story evidence compared with the clearer 2023 refinery overview; do not add only to inflate image count.
Source credits/metadata establish identity, not permission. No Reuters license has been acquired, no purchase attempted, and none of those files is published.

metadataMethod: JPEG APP1/APP13/COM metadata segments removed without changing compressed image scan bytes; APP2 ICC and APP14 color interpretation retained. A minimal reviewed rights-only XMP packet replaces original metadata only where the source identifies an individual photographer. Generated PNG retained byte-for-byte including content credentials. Decoded pixels and ICC compared against acquisition files for each final master.
deliveryNote: Use recommended cover file as the exact same file in article body, once per article. Additional complementary assets are Audi Walker and June FOMC. Covers require object-fit:cover at the manifest focus; source masters and body images remain uncropped. All seven assets have full five-language captions and alt text. No commit or push performed.

validation.sharpMetadataCheck: Passed: no EXIF/IPTC; only exact documented rights-only XMP in Walker and FOMC meeting assets.
validation.iccIdentity: Passed for every asset; Q9 retains its embedded Adobe RGB profile.
validation.coverCropCheck: Rendered 16:9 and 4:3 previews with each recommended focus and visually inspected.
validation.browserCheck: All 25 article editions: desktop 1180 CSS px and narrow 393 CSS px (388 usable), using ordinary browser zoom, not mobile emulation. All seven media assets loaded in each language; no horizontal page overflow.
